evidence.title: Florida poll: Republicans lead in the races for governor and Senate

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll issue question results
occurrences.quote_span: By far the most important issue identified was inflation and the cost of living, with 30% saying it is likeliest to influence their votes.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll Amendment 3 question results
occurrences.quote_span: In the poll of all Florida voters, 55% back the amendment, 26% oppose it, and 19% are undecided.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: Florida property-tax exemption statute
occurrences.quote_span: The exemption cap is currently $50,000.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll toplines for Florida governor
occurrences.quote_span: Donalds, a congressman from the southwest corner of the state, is at 48% in the poll, compared with Jolly’s 41%, in a race in which Donalds has had a commanding financial advantage.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: Florida Amendment 3 ballot text and endorsements by the Florida Republican Party and Gov. Ron DeSantis
occurrences.quote_span: The state Republican Party and term-limited Gov. Ron DeSantis support a ballot measure, known as Amendment 3, that would increase property tax exemptions to the first $250,000 of a home’s value by 2028.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll toplines on Trump job approval
occurrences.quote_span: Trump’s job performance rating, however, is underwater, with 49% disapproving of his job performance, compared with 45% who approve.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll methodology and sample records
occurrences.quote_span: The overall survey questioned 625 registered voters, all of whom said they were likely to vote in the November elections.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll toplines on Trump job approval
occurrences.quote_span: Overall, 48% of all Florida likely voters approve of Trump’s job performance and 48% disapprove.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll toplines
occurrences.quote_span: Republican Byron Donalds holds a 7-percentage-point advantage over Democrat David Jolly in the Florida governor’s race, according to a new NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll, while Republican Sen. Ashley Moody is up by 10 points in her matchup against Democratic challenger Angie Nixon.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll issue question results
occurrences.quote_span: Immigration enforcement was the fourth most important issue among Hispanic voters (12%).
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll issue question results
occurrences.quote_span: In both the overall sample and the sample of Hispanic voters, “direction of the state or country” (17%) was the second most important issue.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll Amendment 3 crosstabs
occurrences.quote_span: Nearly three-quarters (74%) of Republicans supported the idea, compared with 36% for Democrats and 43% for independents.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll toplines for Florida Senate
occurrences.quote_span: Moody is at 50% in the Senate race, compared with 40% for Nixon, a Democratic Socialists of America-aligned candidate who got into the general election after a surprise primary victory over Democrat Alexander Vindman in August.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group Hispanic-sample methodology
occurrences.quote_span: The same time frame and methods were used to survey 400 Hispanic registered voters, with a margin of error of plus or minus 5 percentage points.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll crosstabs for Hispanic voters
occurrences.quote_span: Donalds holds a 48%-43% lead over Jolly among Hispanic voters, according to the survey, while Moody is up 47%-40% over Nixon.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll issue question results
occurrences.quote_span: The broader polling data put “immigration enforcement” as the third most important issue (16%), while the Hispanic sample put property taxes (13%) as the third most important issue.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll immigration-enforcement policy question results
occurrences.quote_span: Among all voters, 85% of Republicans support the policy, compared with 18% of Democrats and 44% of those identified as independent voters who supported the harsher immigration enforcement tactics.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Station Group poll methodology
occurrences.quote_span: They were interviewed over the telephone by Mason-Dixon Polling & Research Inc. from Sept. 28 to Thursday, with a margin of error of plus or minus 4 percentage points.
occurrences.speaker: NBC News
occurrences.subject: NBC South Florida/Telemundo Florida poll of 2026 Florida midterm voters
